marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX XR Series Cordless High Torque Impact Wrench features a brushless motor and offers 1420 ft-lb fastening torque and 1900 ft-lb breakaway torque. This tool has a 3/4 in drive size, 3 speed settings, and a glass filled nylon housing. It is a cordless tool with a compact overall length of 10-7/10 in.
